items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices but mixed benchmark results
items.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra costs $8/$40 per million tokens (20% below GPT-6 Astra) and Sol stays at $2/$10. New 2-hour and 8-hour background completion windows cut costs 30-40%. Astra reached OpenAI's High threshold for AI self-improvement.
items.why: OpenAI's latest models cut API prices by 20% and add cheaper background completion windows, lowering the cost of building AI agents. Early benchmarks show GPT-6.2 Astra trailing Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon on some third-party tests, keeping the frontier race tight.

items.headline: Gemini Tasks rolls out free in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India
items.summary: Google drops the premium requirement for Tasks in six countries, running on the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model. New features include Google Pay checkout, calling businesses on your behalf and email forwarding to gemini@google.com.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO oversubscribed 6-7x with Amazon at 14.7% and Google at 13.7% post-offering
items.summary: Order books closed Tuesday with pricing expected above the $70-$78 range. Seven chip and cloud firms committed $26B in non-voting stock. Trading begins Thursday on Nasdaq under ticker ANT.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales with 30+ partner plugins for CRM, prospecting and calls
items.summary: The sales plugin integrates Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, ZoomInfo, Gong and Otter.ai. A dot agent handles meeting briefs and deal tracking automatically.

items.headline: Gemini API adds native Word, PowerPoint, Excel and OpenDocument processing with content slicing
items.summary: Documents, spreadsheets, videos and audio can now be sliced by page, worksheet, cell range, time interval or content layer directly in the Gemini API.

items.headline: Google reportedly extends Gemini chat retention to 2 months and splits the history toggle
items.summary: TechCrunch reports Google now keeps Gemini chats for 2 months even with history off, up from 72 hours. The update also separates chat history from AI model training into distinct settings.

items.headline: Claude adds linked billing API so partner apps can charge usage to a customer's own org
items.summary: Developers can now let their customers pay for Claude usage through their own Claude organization, with spend caps per request. Uses a new beta API header.

items.headline: Claude Desktop adds release channel picker with Stable and Latest update tracks
items.summary: Users can now choose between Stable (less frequent updates, more testing) and Latest (daily updates) release channels in Claude Desktop settings.

items.headline: Le Groupe Figaro partners with OpenAI to bring its journalism into ChatGPT with attribution
items.summary: Le Figaro's content will appear in ChatGPT as summaries and excerpts with links back to the original articles.

items.headline: OpenAI partners with the Government of Chile for responsible AI adoption and startup support
items.summary: The partnership covers public-sector AI skills training, responsible adoption frameworks and support for Chilean startups building with OpenAI tools.

items.headline: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe adds voice-driven editing, rewriting and formatting capabilities
items.summary: The gemini-3.5-transcribe and gemini-3.5-transcribe-live models now support voice-driven editing and formatting in the Gemini API.

items.headline: Google Home speakers reportedly getting Gemini Live with faster responses and smart home commands
items.summary: 9to5Google reports the upgrade brings mid-session commands for timers and smart home controls. Requires Google Home Premium at $10 per month.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Neon model spotted in Google Cloud SKU catalog and Antigravity CLI
items.summary: TestingCatalog found pricing at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens, positioned as a Pro orchestrator. Google has not announced the model.

items.headline: Claude Google Docs connector hit elevated errors for about 75 minutes, now resolved
items.summary: Editing documents through the Google Docs connector failed on claude.ai, Claude Code and Claude Cowork from 00:19 to 01:33 UTC on November 18. Reading was not affected.
